column1: # This release's copy of port/game/rac2-ntsc/split_places.tsv, by its names (release_carry.py).
# The draw callback lists: the same code on other addresses, so the catalogue gives each level's copy
# a name of its own instead of the executable's. Each copy is given back to the routine it is, whose
# C then finds that list's addresses in the level by pairing, as for any other function.
# Levels 8, 9, 19 and 30 also register into the fourth list (func_L08_002F2C48, host/callback_lists.c).
# func_L00_00424BB8 (a two-float setter on D_L00_001B8E10's object): in levels 16, 22, 23 and 26 the copy stores at +0x3C/+0x40, not +0x144/+0x148.
